invariants: configuration existence is independent from user visibility
configuration existence is independent from user editability
internal/hidden configuration must still be typed and governed
saved revision is not active configuration
mutable configuration requires a real runtime consumer
configuration, secrets, derived state, product invariants, and implementation constants are distinct
configuration semantics are independent from physical backing
a configuration namespace has exactly one write authority at a time
managed configuration has a human-readable versioned non-authority projection/export
declarative files may be authoritative configuration sources
extension owner-native configuration is allowed and may optionally project typed fields into Management

managementProjection.authority: canonical configuration schema and activation semantics
managementProjection.rule: all administratively meaningful configuration must be inspectable/manageable through the Management Contract according to manageability; GUI rendering is not a Foundation requirement

revisionSemantics.declarativeFile: current file is write authority; validated source digests get immutable historical materialization/ref
revisionSemantics.ownerNative: owner source version/digest with optional typed projection

codecBoundary.otherFormats: owner-native or explicit codec contribution; not a Foundation mandatory dependency
codecBoundary.authorityRule: codec interprets the authoritative file; codec output/history does not become a second write authority
